profile.name: AMI带持久电流开关的超导磁体
profile.name_en: AMI Superconducting Magnet with Persistent Current Switch
profile.description: 这是一套带持久电流开关的超导磁体系统，可由外部电流源励磁，并切换到持久模式以提供稳定磁场。常用于低温实验、量子器件测试和材料测量中的磁场设定、扫场与长期稳场。
profile.description_en: This is a superconducting magnet system with a persistent current switch. It can be energized by an external current source and switched into persistent mode to provide a stable magnetic field. It is commonly used for magnetic field biasing, field sweeps, and long-term field stability in cryogenic experiments, quantum device measurements, and materials characterization.
